acceptance: Record fixed future Git paths and write none now.
Bind Git safety and source hashes.
Record missing repository and identity as unmet preconditions.
Define one owner consequential Gate-G1 for any future mutation.
Provide RESULT, MODIFIED, DIFF, VERIFICATION, and ROLLBACK evidence.
Record offline tests, review, doctor, and Git safety with external actions false.
inputs.metric: Deterministic PREVIEW_ONLY paths, Gate-G1, hashes, resume condition, rollback, and empty read-only changed paths.
non_goals: Do not modify real Git or external systems.
Do not change Ledger, receipts, snapshots, or unrelated files.
Do not represent preview as product delivery.
inputs.outcome: Create APG-only PREVIEW_ONLY local Git checkpoint transaction evidence; no repository initialization or commit.
inputs.problem: APG offline checkpoint advice needs a bounded local Git checkpoint preview without Git writes.
inputs.rollback: Run the preview ROLLBACK.sh on a disposable copy; preserve receipts and never touch .git.
inputs.rollout: Create only plan-change preview and local evidence; then run offline validation and disposable rollback. Any real checkpoint is a separate apply transaction after Gate-G1.
